qualification: shared-host provisional CPU timings; CPU and GPU are separately measured

host.limitation: shared host; CPU timings provisional pending uncontended repeat

protocol.comparison: all elements; abs(a-e) <= atol+rtol*abs(e); finite required
protocol.in_place_timing: single calls, input reset outside events
protocol.ntt_operation_budget_units: radix-2 butterflies for all-power-of-two shapes; direct DFT terms otherwise
protocol.ntt_reference: exact integer radix-2 butterflies; direct DFT for non-power-of-two axes

timing_formula: CPU median wall-clock microseconds / complete-call backend microseconds
transfer_policy: host-device transfers excluded on the GPU side; required operator conversions remain in both timings
